From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice 5678 — hold reason and evidence request

Hi Anna — thanks for flagging this.

Short answer: we need either a verified EU VAT ID (VIES lookup) showing Skylume AB is registered for VAT in Sweden, or a signed supplier declaration confirming you are the taxable person so the reverse-charge can apply. The hold was triggered because our automated VAT check returned a mismatch between the VAT field on the invoice and the company registration number in your billing profile.

If you can upload the VAT certificate (PDF) and a simple signed declaration (PDF) to the evidence portal link below we can start the review. To avoid delaying your payout entirely, our standard remediation for cases like this is a partial payment release while we review the documents. Proposed approach: release 75% of the invoice now, hold 25% until the evidence is verified and the VIES check is clear — if the docs validate, we release the remainder immediately and confirm via email.

Portal: https://drive.redwood.ai/finance/Skylume/invoice-5678
Required docs:
- VAT registration certificate (PDF)
- Signed supplier declaration confirming VAT status and responsible legal entity (PDF)
- Copy of invoice (PDF) — include the VAT ID field clearly

If you prefer escalation, I can loop in Finance for an expedited full release pending manual review — let me know.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Senior Account Manager — Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Invoice 5678 — VAT certificate and signed declaration attached

Chloe / Marissa — reviewed the attachments. Summary of checks and recommendation:

1) VAT evidence: the VAT certificate is a valid Swedish registration document. We also ran a VIES lookup (screenshot saved to the Skylume folder) which returns an active VAT ID for SE556123789001.
2) Reverse-charge: as this is B2B digital services to an EU-registered business, reverse-charge is the correct treatment. No VAT should have been included on the invoice if Skylume is the supplier of the service (we need to confirm who is the supplier on the invoice header — looks correct).
3) Risk control: standard practice is to hold a small retention in case of later tax adjustments or audit disputes. Given the size, I propose releasing 90% now and retaining 10% as a reconciliation reserve (EUR 4,800). This balances Skylume's cashflow needs and our audit risk. If VIES re-affirms status (which it did), release the remaining 10% within 3 business days after we confirm bookkeeping passes.

Action items for ops:
- Chloe: confirm to Skylume that Redwood will release EUR 43,200 (90%) today and that we will clear the remainder within 3 business days upon bookkeeping confirmation.
- Marissa: flag for payments queue and add the VIES screenshot and attachments to the payment record (HubSpot HS-10234).
- Finance will not require a PO for this vendor on this invoice, per the existing contract (see clause 4.2).

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Finance Manager — Payments & Collections
Redwood Inference

Hi Anna — good news. Finance reviewed the VAT certificate and VIES lookup and will release 90% of invoice 5678 today (EUR 43,200). The remaining 10% (EUR 4,800) will be held as a short reconciliation reserve and released within 3 business days after we confirm the bookkeeping entries.

What we recorded from your docs:
- VAT ID: SE556123789001 (VIES verified)
- Supplier declaration received (signed PDF)
- Invoice copy matched the billing profile

Next steps for you: nothing required unless we find an inconsistency. If you prefer immediate full release, we can consider a one-time expedited payout subject to a formal waiver to allow Redwood to recover funds if a later tax adjustment occurs — let me know if you'd like that route and I'll escalate.

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for uploading the files to the portal. Payment reference: RDW-PMT-20260915-5678.
